description: Read the workspace's referral link to share. A new user whose first workspace comes from it starts with 30 days of Paid and 1,000 credits; that workspace's first payment gives this workspace 1,000 credits, plus 30 days of Paid unless a Stripe subscription or an unbounded grant already covers it. Any member may read it.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.
